quotes.text: Preserve useful failures. D325606 changed a numeric completion status to rejection so callers retain a stack, added a folder-creation failure test, and used the component send logger. D322584 asked for an accurate error code and a comment that `nsMimeNewURI()` can return null on parse failure. These are local contracts, not a ban on status results. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D325606
